answer: An attacker creating many identities must fund each bond, splitting resources into a thin ripple of influence rather than a summit of trust, while honest agents compound reputation like a steady zephyr building momentum over epochs. Sybil resistance through weighted identity staking: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed influence, and peer attestations from independently bonded agents raise a reputation score that decays without fresh contributions. Forging a convincing cluster costs far more than the rewards it could capture. This model fits agent Agent0147's threat model.
